title: Industry Additional Restrictions
label: 05-Industry-Specific Restrictions
markdown:
# Industry Additional Restrictions

|  |
| --- |
| The following are general summaries, which should also be preceded by industry reviews, qualifications, necessary warnings and platform rules: |

| Industry/scenario | High-risk expression not to be used or claimed |
| --- | --- |
| Medical, pharmaceutical, medical equipment | Efficacy or safety assertion and assurance; cure rate, efficiency; comparison with other medicines, equipment safety or medical institutions; use of proximate evidence; treatment of the drug to the disease, cure, cure, zero side effects. Advertisements subject to review may not be reviewed and published. |
| Health food | Treatment or prevention of disease, necessary to protect health, substitution of drugs, absolute guarantees of efficacy or safety, prosecution by the spokesperson. |
| Education, training | Guaranteed commitment to promotion, examination, degree, certificate or training. |
| Financial, financial, business and investment returns | Guaranteed security, insured income, zero risk, risk-free, secure and uncompensated, earned, laid, doubled, X million monthly, and guaranteed future earnings; reasonable warning of risk and liability. |
| Real estate | Assurances of appreciation, guarantees of return on investment, guarantees of accommodation/attendance, distance in the time required to reach a place, financing contrary to policy or disguised financing. |
| Cosmetics and life beauty | Treatment, inflammation, bactericide, restoration DNA, permanent whiteness, immediate plastering, drug-grade, medical level treatment or pharmacological expression, and declarations of efficacy beyond registration, filing, labelling or evaluation. |
| Food and ordinary drinks | Medicines such as medical treatment, disease prevention, reduction of three heights, cancer resistance, increased immunity, detoxification, diet assurance, extended longevity, health-care food or medical effects expression. |
| Pesticides, veterinary medicines, feed and feed additives | (b) The assertion of efficacy or safety, assurances, expressions of efficiency, violation of safe use protocols, and evidence of recommendation prohibited by law. |
| Tobacco, electronic smoke | The Internet may not be used for advertising and may not be used for propaganda through other goods, services or public service advertisements. |
| Wine | Inducing or encouraging drinking, promoting unbridled drinking, displaying drinking or driving, and implying that drinking can remove anxiety or increase physical strength. |
